question: In a certain code, METHOD is written as DOHTEM. How will CHOCOLATE be written as in that code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c60b503650f9d70318ed7aed73ada204c0608383f13dced4faa5f09c580c5fee.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• METHOD is written as DOHTEM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/081aa33fa5885ee02f4e9db771191a30b6a17821009ca5c1c17ec3370b295c20.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **CHOCOLATE will be written as :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e64a99a190a2e1fe3b3d198ab0febc2cdd20273b1cafd0b72e554e7bb2ad5a32.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ETALOCOHC".**
